subject.title: fix(agents): reject execCommand's promise on AbortSignal cancellation

question: Should the public plugin-facing `ExtensionContext.exec()` contract treat caller-requested AbortSignal cancellation as a rejected operation rather than as a resolved killed result?
rationale: This is a behavior change at a plugin-facing execution boundary, and repository policy treats plugin API behavior changes as compatibility-sensitive even when the method signature is unchanged.

options.title: Adopt rejection semantics
options.body: Accept caller cancellation as an error path, with focused compatibility documentation or tests proving timeout and output-limit behavior remain distinct.

options.title: Preserve resolved killed results
options.body: Keep the current resolved-result contract for callers that cancel commands and close this patch unless a new additive API can avoid ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Adopt rejection semantics
recommendation.body: Accept caller cancellation as an error path, with focused compatibility documentation or tests proving timeout and output-limit behavior remain distinct.
